clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/databases/drop with dbName='nonexistent_db_47767' (database that doesn't exist)
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 with code 0 (success) - API incorrectly returns success when dropping non-existent database

contract_refs: endpoint: databases+drop should return error when database doesn't exist (404 not found or similar)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 DropDatabase request -> MetaTable.DropDatabase -> getDatabaseByNameInternal -> not found -> returns nil (BUG) -> HTTP 200 success response
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:DropDatabase函数在internal/rootcoord/meta_table.go第434-436行,当数据库不存在时记录警告日志但返回nil而非错误。这导致REST API返回HTTP 200成功响应,而非预期的错误响应(如404)。这是一个真实的bug - 幂等操作应该返回成功,但删除不存在的资源应该返回错误。

falsification.probe: Dropping non-existent database returns HTTP 200 - incorrectly indicates success. Dropping existing database works correctly.
falsification.observed: Bug confirmed - idempotency issue: dropping existing database works correctly, but dropping non-existent database should return error, not success.

cognition_match.note: 未命中任何已知的by_design模式,幂等操作错误处理是真正的bug

contract.explicit_requirement: drop on non-existent database should return error (404 or similar)

physical.objective_constraint: Cannot delete non-existent resource - should return error

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED + verdict_B=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (contract violation + physical constraint violation)

verdicts.rationale: Milvus databases+drop API incorrectly returns HTTP 200 success when dropping non-existent database。源码接地发现 MetaTable.DropDatabase 函数在数据库不存在时返回nil而非错误(第434-436行),导致API错误地将删除失败响应为成功。幂等操作的正确行为应该是:删除存在的数据库返回成功,删除不存在的数据库返回错误(如404)。当前实现违反了这一原则,可能导致客户端误判删除操作状态。这是真实的bug,不是预期行为。
